text: If we have our own why in life, we shall get along with almost any how.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
visual_brief: A technical schematic of a three-axis gimbaled gyroscope rendered in precise white drafting lines on a black background. Curved motion arrows indicate the outer concentric brass rings pitching and rolling through turbulent angles, while the weighted central rotor remains undisturbed on its true horizontal axis.
alt: Technical drawing of a gimbaled gyroscope maintaining level orientation amid tilting rings.
